chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 09 (Full Book Model Paper 1)
subject: physics-10

questions.question: The loudness of sound heard by a human ear is directly proportional to the square of its:
questions.explanation: Sound intensity and perceptual loudness scale with the square of the vibrational amplitude (I ∝ A²).

questions.question: The most heavily doped region of a bipolar junction transistor (BJT) is the:
questions.explanation: The emitter is heavily doped to inject large numbers of charge carriers into the thin, lightly doped base.

questions.question: The heat transfer mechanism that occurs due to density differences and macroscopic movement in fluids is:
questions.explanation: Convection occurs in liquids and gases where heated less dense fluid rises and cooler denser fluid sinks (convection currents).

questions.question: The half-life of completely stable atomic isotopes is theoretically:
questions.explanation: Stable nuclei do not undergo spontaneous radioactive decay; their decay constant λ = 0, so half-life T = ln 2 / λ = ∞.

questions.question: If a simple pendulum completes 22 full vibrations in 11 seconds, its frequency is:
questions.explanation: Frequency f = vibrations / time = 22 / 11 s = 2.0 Hz.

questions.question: A step-up transformer has a turn ratio (Ns:Np) of 3:2. If the primary voltage is 30 V, the secondary voltage is:
The radius of curvature of a spherical mirror is 20 cm. What is its focal length?
questions.explanation: For any spherical mirror, focal length equals half the radius of curvature: f = R/2 = 20/2 = 10 cm.

questions.question: Which of the following environmental factors increases the rate of liquid evaporation?
questions.explanation: Increasing temperature gives surface liquid molecules higher kinetic energy to escape intermolecular attractive forces.

questions.question: The electrical resistance of a uniform metallic wire does NOT depend on its:
questions.explanation: Resistance R = ρL/A depends on length L, cross-sectional area A, and resistivity ρ (and temperature), but not directly on mass density.

questions.question: The majority charge carriers in the emitter region of an NPN transistor are:
questions.explanation: N-type semiconductor material is doped with pentavalent donor atoms, producing free electrons as majority carriers.

questions.question: The work done in moving a unit positive test charge along any closed path in an electrostatic field is:
questions.explanation: Electrostatic fields are conservative fields; the line integral of electric field around any closed loop is zero (∮ E · dl = 0).

questions.question: A radioactive element has a half-life of 2 years. What percentage of the initial sample remains undecayed after 6 years?
questions.explanation: Number of half-lives n = 6 / 2 = 3. Remaining fraction = (1/2)³ = 1/8 = 0.125 = 12.5%.
